Game Overview

Riyoo is a adventure title where guide a courageous girl through a vibrant and dynamic 2D platformer, using agility and reflexes to collect flowers and outsmart enemies. Master timing with the double jump mechanic, tackle sharp spikes, and relish escalating challenges across intricately crafted levels that transform each step into an adventure.
